* EapSilentException represents a category of EAP errors that should be silently discarded by * authenticators and peers. * *

EapSilentException is so-named due to its role in the EAP standard. RFC 3748 requires that * several error cases be "silently discarded". In these cases, no EAP-Response message will be sent * to the Authenticator. However, when thrown SilentExceptions will still signal an EAP failure to * the IKE library calling it, resulting in an Authentication failure. * * Each type of silent error should implement its own subclass.
